---
title: "Step 7: PFAS Source Term"
---

See **_Appendix 7.1 REMFluor-MD Source Concentrations_** for more info.

## Initial Source Concentration

<div style="overflow-x: auto;">

| **Parameter** | **INITIAL SOURCE CONCENTRATION** |
| --- | --- |
| Description | Initial source zone concentration when the simulation starts. |
| Units | μg/L |
| Typical Values | 0.01 to 1000 μg/L. |
| Source of Data | <span class="bullet-item">• This concentration represents the concentration in a vertical plane source leaving the source and forming the plume.</span><span class="bullet-item">• The user has to translate the groundwater monitoring data from the source zone to a representative concentration of the high concentration plume core leaving the source.</span><span class="bullet-item">• One practical approach for selecting the representative source concentration is to evaluate plume maps with concentration contours and identify a modeled source-plane width that appears to capture approximately 75% or more of the high-concentration zone leaving the source area.</span><span class="bullet-item">• There are three general options for modeling a PFAS source in groundwater in units of ng/L or μg/L over time are to use:</span><span style="display: block; padding-left: 3em; text-indent: -1.5em; margin: 0;">1. A simple constant source term (this is the only selection for the ("Simple Version").</span><span style="display: block; padding-left: 3em; text-indent: -1.5em; margin: 0;">2. A flexible source term where users enter their own concentration vs. time ("Detailed Version").</span><span style="display: block; padding-left: 3em; text-indent: -1.5em; margin: 0;">3. A tool to upload concentration data from models such as PFAS-leach ("Detailed Version").</span><br><br>See **_Appendix 7.1 REMFluor-MD Source Concentrations_** for more info. |
| How to Enter Data | Enter directly. |

</div>
